description: This file defines a Vue.js Pinia store for managing user preferences, including device settings, user settings, server settings, and space management. It includes functions for loading, updating, and switching spaces, as well as theme application based on user preferences.

methods.name: loadUserSettings
methods.description: Loads user preferences from the backend API and updates the store accordingly.

methods.name: loadDefaultUnit
methods.description: Fetches the default unit from the backend API and sets it in the store.

methods.name: updateUserSettings
methods.description: Saves modified user preferences back to the backend API.

methods.name: loadServerSettings
methods.description: Retrieves server settings from the API.

methods.name: loadActiveSpace
methods.description: Loads the current active space data from the API.

methods.name: loadUserSpaces
methods.description: Loads the list of user spaces with permissions.

methods.name: loadSpaces
methods.description: Lists all spaces accessible to the user.

methods.name: switchSpace
methods.description: Switches the active space to the specified one.

methods.name: resetDeviceSettings
methods.description: Resets device settings to default values.

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Applies theme based on user preferences and print mode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the store by loading all necessary data and applying theme.
